Failure can trap or stall this utility, but adversarial serving reachability is not established. Integration must verify admission comparison and sealed collective peer binding against A-001/A-003, TB-002/TB-007 and T-053; agreement comments are not proof. Trace Gemma4TensorParallelPrefix selection/capture and serving callers to establish authenticated account/model/rank scope, SSD encryption/HMAC/TTL, kill-switch behavior and resident-cache eligibility under T-041. Geometry compatibility alone cannot establish prefix provenance. Also reconcile token/count bounds and cancellation/authorization checks supplied to paged prefill/decode with T-010/T-053: these internal methods rely on callers and CBv2 state execution. No credential, billing, fan-helper or installer changes are visible. Remaining contracts are outside this batch, not observed missing controls.
